Southeast Asia has been a backpacking staple for decades, and while the well-worn routes are popular for good reason, a bit of preparation makes the trip much smoother.

## Visas and borders

Rules vary widely by country and change often, so it's worth checking current visa requirements a few weeks before you travel rather than relying on older trip reports.

## Packing light

Humidity and heat make heavy packs miserable, and most travelers find that a smaller bag with quick-dry clothing serves them far better than a full backpacking setup.

## Budgeting day to day

Costs vary enormously between countries in the region, and travelers who track spending loosely by category tend to avoid the surprise of running low on cash mid-trip.

Overland travel between countries is often cheaper and more scenic than flying, and buses or trains also give you a better sense of how the landscape changes as you cross each border.
